title: Owner: ask NERV for the live index in chat
goal: The owner sees the index's card in NERV's chat on the Mac
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the update, with the index running (coordinator:F-024-T07), type in chat: `cosa aspetta me?` Expected: a card titled in Italian listing the owner steps waiting on you, each with a link to its source file and the index's snapshot time, and a link that opens the index screen. Then type `cosa blocca coordinator:F-024?` Expected: a card listing the steps whose dependsOn names it, or a line saying there are none
privacy: Neutral invented records, repositories and results only; no tokens in configuration examples, tests or logs.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-147 Verification
escalation: The owner decides whether the card is enough; the agent records the result

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: two chat messages on the Mac. Not a measurement.
